contract: Index scores with the reference's bf16 arithmetic (DeepSeek model.py: einsum, relu, mul, sum in bf16) written relative to each row's key start, as 16-bit order-preserving keys or f32 values for topk windows; each row's exact top-k (ties at the cut by ascending column) written as offset + (column - start), ascending, -1 padded; the fused score + select of up to two independent eight-row groups. Adapted from pico's indexer (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Andy Shu).
